notes.subject: Kristy call notes — 2026 outreach
notes.body: Kristy's handwritten notes show she spoke with Ruby on May 12, 2026 and sent information for Lapwai Days. Gmail confirms Ruby Moses proactively emailed Adventure Zone that day asking for information for the July 9-12, 2026 event, and Amy replied. Older Gmail history shows prior discussion of pricing, public charge, space and insurance. Source: handwritten call notes page 83; Adventure Zone Gmail.
